text.7:200: And if a slander from the devil wound thee, then seek refuge in Allah. Lo! He is Hearer, Knower.
text.16:98: And when thou recitest the Qur'an, seek refuge in Allah from Satan the outcast.
text.40:56: Lo! those who wrangle concerning the revelations of Allah without a warrant having come unto them, there is naught else in their breasts save pride which they will never attain. So take thou refuge in Allah. Lo! He, only He, is the Hearer, the Seer.
text.41:36: And if a whisper from the devil reach thee (O Muhammad) then seek refuge in Allah. Lo! He is the Hearer, the Knower.
